description:
Root `AGENTS.md` is the authoritative operational guide. `CONTRIBUTING.md` duplicates it except for a Code of Conduct link and pull-request content guidance, so the file is retired and its unique guidance gets one home.

## Background

Consumers and overlap are listed in `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` §3.6; the only live consumer is a link in the root README. Root `AGENTS.md` sits close to its 200-line limit.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `CONTRIBUTING.md` is absent from the tree.
- [hard] REQ-02: The Code of Conduct link and pull-request content guidance appear in root `AGENTS.md`, or are dropped with the reason recorded in the commit message.
- [hard] REQ-03: No live file links to `CONTRIBUTING.md`; mentions inside archived or historical records are unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-04: Root `AGENTS.md` stays at or below 200 lines.
title: Retire CONTRIBUTING.md in favor of AGENTS.md
